name: Rahul's Chai Nashta
tagline: Fresh chai and nashta from our home stall in Aliganj, Lucknow
about: I'm Rahul, and I run a small chai-nashta stall from my home in Aliganj, Lucknow. We serve kulhad chai, masala chai and simple snacks like bun maska, samosa and poha. We also take bulk orders for offices, just let us know one day before.
hours: Open 7 AM to 11 AM and 5 PM to 9 PM. Closed on Mondays.

products.name: Office bulk chai (20 cup flask)
products.description: Flask of 20 cups, order one day before

section_copy.hero_line: Kulhad chai, bun maska and hot snacks from our Aliganj stall
section_copy.about: I'm Rahul, and I run a small home chai-nashta stall in Aliganj, Lucknow. We serve chai and nashta every morning and evening, except Mondays. Offices can order chai in bulk too.
section_copy.how_ordering: Choose your items and send your order. Office bulk orders need to be placed one day ahead.
